:::{#hero-heading}

I’m a Computer Engineer focused on Site Reliability Engineering. For more than a decade, I’ve been designing and operating infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments, building systems that behave *predictably* at scale.

My work focuses on systems performance and observability engineering, with a particular interest in understanding how systems evolve and their underlying dynamics.

I recently completed an MSc in Quantum Computing and Quantum Technologies, studying the interface between quantum and classical computing.

Alongside my engineering work, I compose electro-acoustic music. Although these fields may appear distant, they share a common *thread*. Each is, at its core, about *understanding* systems deeply enough to *compute* their *dynamics*.

In this blog, I share technical notes, experiments, and projects around Site Reliability Engineering, distributed systems, cloud, and quantum computing.

:::
